title: Marketing Tech Ops - GHL Specialist
description:
About the job

GoHighLevel (GHL) Specialist — Remote, Mexico

Harvest Health Marketing, a division of Harvest Company, is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with cash-pay chiropractic clinics. GoHighLevel is the backbone of everything we build for our clients — from lead capture to follow-up automation to appointment booking — and we need someone who knows the platform inside and out.

We are looking for an experienced GHL Specialist based in Mexico who can build complex automations, troubleshoot technical issues, create high-converting landing pages, set up SMS campaigns, manage A2P registration for client phone numbers, and configure accurate ad-platform tracking. This is a technical role that requires precision, problem-solving, and the ability to work closely with a U.S.-based team in real time.

About the Role

You will own the technical buildout and ongoing maintenance of GoHighLevel systems for our chiropractic clinic clients. Every client we onboard needs a fully functional GHL environment — pipelines, automations, landing pages, forms, calendars, SMS campaigns, email sequences, and conversion tracking — built correctly from the start and maintained as the business evolves.

You will work directly with our team to understand each client's workflow and translate that into a GHL build that runs without constant intervention. When things break — and sometimes they do — you will be the person who diagnoses and fixes it quickly.

This role requires daily availability during business hours for team meetings via Microsoft Teams. Strong communication is non-negotiable. If you cannot attend live meetings or communicate clearly in English, this role is not the right fit.

Required Skills & Experience

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:

• 3+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience — not familiarity, actual buildout and management experience

• Proven ability to build complex, multi-step automations including conditional logic, triggers, wait steps, and branching workflows

• Experience building and optimizing landing pages inside GHL — forms, funnels, and conversion-focused design

• Experience setting up SMS campaigns including drip sequences, appointment reminders, and lead follow-up automations

• Direct experience completing A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers — you understand the process, the requirements, and how to troubleshoot rejections

• Hands-on experience setting up Meta Conversions API (CAPI) — you can configure server-side event tracking for Meta/Facebook ads, including deduplication with the pixel and event matching for lead and purchase events

• Hands-on experience setting up offline conversion tracking for Google Ads — you can build and manage offline conversion imports so closed/won leads are matched back to the originating ad click

• In-depth understanding of UTM parameters and source tracking within GHL — you can set up and audit UTM tagging and traffic-source attribution so every lead can be traced back to the ad, campaign, and platform that generated it

• Strong troubleshooting ability — you can diagnose why an automation isn't firing, why a form isn't submitting, or why a message isn't delivering (or why a conversion isn't tracking) and fix it without hand-holding

• Excellent written and spoken English — you will attend daily meetings, communicate with team members, and document your builds clearly

• Fast, stable internet connection capable of supporting daily video calls via Microsoft Teams without interruption

• Availability to attend daily team meetings during U.S. business hours (schedule to be confirmed)

Applications without demonstrated GHL experience will not be reviewed. Be prepared to walk through a build you have completed.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with GHL sub-account setup and white-label agency environments

• Familiarity with Zapier or Make (Integromat) for third-party integrations

• Experience integrating GHL with Meta Lead Ads or Google Ads for automatic lead ingestion

• Background working with U.S.-based digital marketing agencies or healthcare-adjacent businesses

• Understanding of HIPAA-conscious communication practices for medical or healthcare clients




Responsibilities

• Build and configure GHL sub-accounts for new clients including pipelines, stages, tags, and custom fields

• Design and build complex automations for lead follow-up, appointment booking, no-show re-engagement, and nurture sequences

• Build landing pages, opt-in forms, and funnels optimized for patient lead generation

• Set up and manage SMS and email campaigns including A/B testing and performance monitoring

• Complete A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers and manage compliance requirements

• Set up and maintain Meta Conversions API integrations and Google Ads offline conversion imports for client accounts

• Implement and audit UTM parameters and source/attribution tracking in GHL so lead and conversion data ties back to the correct ad campaign

• Troubleshoot automation failures, integration issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform errors quickly and thoroughly

• Document all builds clearly so the team understands what was built and why

• Attend daily team meetings via Microsoft Teams and communicate progress, blockers, and completed work

• Maintain and update existing client GHL environments as strategies evolve




Compensation

• Fixed monthly rate — based on experience and scope of work

• Compensation discussed after skills assessment and initial interview

• Long-term contract with potential for rate increases as the relationship and workload grow




Who Thrives in This Role

• You are technically precise — you build things correctly the first time and test before handing off

• You communicate proactively — you flag issues before they become problems and ask questions before going in the wrong direction

• You take ownership of your builds — if something isn't working, you don't wait to be asked, you fix it

• You are reliable and present — daily meetings aren't optional and your availability during U.S. hours is consistent

• You learn fast — GHL updates frequently and you stay current without being asked

If you are looking for a role where you work independently without communication or live collaboration, this is not the right fit. We operate as a team and expect you to be a present, communicative part of it.

About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

About the job

PoderJudicialVirtual.com | 100% remoto 




Resumen del rol

Buscamos al ingeniero que se sumará al equipo que va a construir el próximo producto de PoderJudicialVirtual de punta a punta y llevarlo a producción. Es un rol de constructor dentro de un equipo de desarrollo: entre todos toman la especificación, diseñan el backend en Laravel, construyen el frontend en Vue, integran los pagos con Stripe y lo lanzan a miles de usuarios reales. Con ownership real de tu parte del producto, sin capas intermedias y sin nadie revisándote el hombro.

No es un asiento más en una fábrica de software. Estamos ejecutando nuestro plan 2030: pasar de 2 productos en producción a 11 y expandirnos a Sudamérica. Tú construyes el primero de esa nueva ola, y quien construye bien aquí se convierte en pieza central de todo lo que sigue. El crecimiento se gana construyendo, no por antigüedad.

Te integrarás a un equipo de desarrollo en México, de la mano de un líder técnico fuerte, dueño de la arquitectura y la infraestructura, y de un Product Manager Senior que te entrega specs claras con Definition of Ready y Definition of Done. Tú eres dueño del código: de que escale, de que cobre bien y de que llegue a producción sin sorpresas.

Vas a trabajar sobre un dominio complejo (la infraestructura judicial mexicana) que tarda meses en dominarse. No esperamos que llegues sabiéndolo. Sí esperamos que en pocos meses tomes decisiones técnicas independientes y que tu código hable por ti.




Sobre nosotros

PoderJudicialVirtual es una empresa legaltech mexicana con más de 10 años en el mercado. Operamos la plataforma de datos judiciales más grande de México: más de 65 millones de registros de todo el país, con despachos, empresas y miles de personas usando y pagando el servicio todos los días. Somos rentables y no dependemos de inversionistas para ejecutar nuestro plan.




El proyecto

Arranque en septiembre de 2026. El equipo construirá un producto nuevo completo: backend en Laravel, frontend en Vue, flujo de referidos e integración de pagos con Stripe, desde la spec hasta producción. Al lanzarlo, sigue el próximo producto del plan. Aquí no se mantiene lo de otros: se construye lo propio.




Lo que buscamos




Requisitos:

• 5 años o más de experiencia profesional con PHP, idealmente Laravel.

• Capacidad real de leer, entender y mantener código existente con años de historia, no solo arrancar proyectos desde cero.

• MySQL a escala: has trabajado con tablas de millones de registros y sabes de índices y paginación eficiente.

• Vue.js sólido para trabajo full-stack.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs REST que escalan.

• Ownership: tomas un producto y lo llevas a producción. Detectas tus errores antes de entregar.

• Git con flujo profesional: manejo de branches, pull requests y participación activa en code reviews.

• Entorno de desarrollo Linux: configuración autónoma de stack local en Ubuntu (Apache, PHP, MySQL) sin dependencia de soporte externo.




Deseable (suma puntos, no descarta):

• MongoDB, 2 años o más.

• Automatización web: experiencia con Playwright, Puppeteer y gestión de proxies.

• Cloud: familiaridad con servicios de AWS.

• Inglés de lectura técnica: entender documentación, errores y recursos de desarrollo en inglés. No se requiere hablarlo.

• Experiencia integrando pasarelas de pago; Stripe en particular.




Sobre el uso de IA

Usamos IA todos los días y esperamos que tú también. La regla es simple: la IA amplifica tu criterio, no lo sustituye. Debes entender cada línea que mandas a producción. Durante el proceso vas a defender tu código en vivo, sin asistentes: explicar tus decisiones, encontrar errores en código ajeno y modificar comportamiento en tiempo real.




Soft skills (competencias clave que valoramos):

• Criterio técnico en revisión de código. Capacidad para identificar vulnerabilidades, cuellos de botella y errores de lógica, tanto en código propio como en el generado por IA.

• Ownership del resultado. Asumir plena responsabilidad sobre el código entregado. La IA es una herramienta; las decisiones y sus consecuencias son del desarrollador.

• Autonomía operativa. Capacidad para tomar un proyecto, definir el camino y ejecutarlo de principio a fin. Esperamos consultas estratégicas, no acompañamiento constante.

• Documentación de decisiones. Más allá del código, registrar el razonamiento detrás de las decisiones de arquitectura: el "por qué" que da contexto a futuras iteraciones del equipo.




Lo que ofrecemos

100% remoto.

Bono por objetivos ligado a que tu producto llegue a producción y cobre.
Impacto directo: lo que construyes lo usan miles de abogados y empresas desde el día uno.

title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
description:
About the job

Company Description 

Saya Biologics is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company in Latin America, focused on reducing the access gap to highly specialized biologic treatments. Through international strategic partnerships, we develop, register, commercialize, and distribute biologic and biosimilar medicines across the region. Our mission is to empower thousands of patients through accessible, innovative, and high-quality treatments. At Saya Biologics, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects with a real impact on people’s lives and work in a collaborative and diverse environment driven by scientific and commercial excellence.







Role Description

As a Commercial Excellence Analyst, you will be responsible for measuring, analyzing, and tracking the performance of the sales force across Saya’s different business units. In your day-to-day work, you will build and maintain dashboards, reports, and commercial trackers to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement in coverage, productivity, frequency, conversion, and commercial efficiency. You will also support commercial operations by tracking relationships with distributors, banks, insurers, hospitals, and other institutional stakeholders, ensuring that information, commitments, and next steps are clear and up to date. You will work closely with the Commercial, Finance, and Launch Excellence teams to standardize KPIs, prepare materials for internal reviews, organize key information, and contribute to a disciplined, agile, and well-documented commercial operation. 

This role is ideal for someone in the early stages of their career who wants to learn how the commercial engine of a growing biopharmaceutical company works, combining data analysis, operational coordination, and administrative support. 

This is a full-time position.







Requirements

• Strong analytical skills to work with commercial data, interpret trends, identify deviations, and generate actionable insights. 

• Commercial skills to understand sales operations, performance indicators, commercial productivity, and relationships with stakeholders such as distributors, hospitals, banks, and insurers. 

• Organizational skills to keep dashboards, reports, trackers, repositories, and commercial documentation up to date and well structured. 

• Communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, follow up on commitments, and present information clearly and in an organized manner.

• High attention to detail and a low margin of error when handling data, reports, and follow-up materials. 

• Proactivity to identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and improvements without waiting to be asked. 

• University degree in Business Administration, Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Health Sciences, or related fields. 

• Recent graduate or up to 2 years of experience in internships, analytical, commercial, administrative roles, or related projects. 

• Solid command of Excel or Google Sheets; experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau, CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Veeva, SAP, and Notion is desirable. 

• Advanced English level for reading and writing; bilingual Spanish-English profile is desirable. 

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate data cleaning, analysis, and report preparation, with human judgment and care for confidential information. 

• Ability to work in a dynamic, hybrid, high-growth environment with autonomy, organization, and a results-oriented mindset.

About the job

Sales Manager — Bilingual Call Center Team




Genesis Management | Polanco, MX | On-site | Full-time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM (shifts one hour during U.S. daylight saving time)




Build the team. Grow the leaders. Own the results.




We're looking for a Sales Manager who gets energized by developing people, not just hitting numbers — because here, the numbers follow the coaching.




You'll lead a team of twenty bilingual sales representatives selling our financial services to English-speaking customers. Your day is spent on the floor: listening to calls, coaching in the moment, spotting what's blocking a rep from closing, and helping them break through it. When your team wins, you win.




At Genesis Management, we're more than a call center — we're a community of go-getters driven by passion and purpose. Our values are the fuel behind everything we do:

AMBITION · ADAPTABILITY · RESILIENCE · ENTHUSIASM · COMMITMENT · TEAMWORK

If you've ever wanted the runway to build a sales floor the right way — with real support behind you — this is that role.




Already on our team? We promote from within, and we mean it. Current Genesis reps and team leads are strongly encouraged to apply.




Before you apply

Please submit your resume in English. You'll be coaching English-language sales calls and reviewing English-language customer interactions daily, so fluent written and verbal English is essential. Applications without an English resume can't move forward.




Compensation and benefits

Performance bonus — tied to your team's sales results and retention metrics, not your personal closes. Develop and keep your people, grow your earnings.
Grocery vouchers: 10% of salary, beginning at permanent contract
Comprehensive leadership training, paid, plus ongoing development
Paid professional certifications to grow your credentials on our budget
Statutory benefits from day one — IMSS, paid vacation, aguinaldo, and vacation premium
Referral program: up to $500.00 MXN per successful referral
Executive development opportunities and a clear path to senior leadership as we grow
No evenings. No weekends. Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Because our customers are in the U.S. and Mexico no longer observes daylight saving time, this schedule shifts by one hour — to 7:00 AM–4:00 PM — during the U.S. daylight saving period, roughly March through November.




What you'll do

Coach and develop your team

Monitoring live and recorded calls and delivering specific, actionable feedback
Identifying individual skill gaps — objection handling, call control, active listening — and building targeted coaching plans
Leading huddles and one-on-one coaching sessions to reinforce sales technique and objection handling
Onboarding new reps and getting them productive quickly




Own your team's performance

Setting, tracking, and delivering daily and monthly sales targets across the team
Tracking team KPIs (conversion rate, average handle time, quality scores) and turning them into daily coaching plans
Forecasting performance and reporting results to senior leadership
Managing underperformance fairly and directly, with clear documentation and a real chance to improve




Retain and build the floor

Partnering with recruiting to interview and select new representatives
Driving team engagement and retention through recognition and career development
Owning retention on your team and understanding why people stay or leave




Protect the business

Monitoring call quality and compliance through live listening and call recordings
Maintaining confidentiality of compliance-related information and materials
Verifying accuracy and integrity of customer data entered by your team
Taking on other related duties as assigned




What you'll bring

Required

Fluent English, written and verbal
High school diploma or equivalent
3+ years in sales and/or collections, including at least 1 year formally leading a team
Experience in a high-volume outbound call center environment (our reps make 125+ calls per day)
Demonstrated success coaching individuals to improved sales performance
Comfort working with performance data — reporting, dashboards, and KPI analysis
Strong MS Office skills, especially Excel
Ability to hold people accountable with warmth and directness at the same time




Nice to have

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field
Experience in financial services or a regulated sales environment
Familiarity with CRM and call center platforms (dialers, call recording, QA tools)
Experience building or scaling a sales team from a small base




How to apply

To apply, submit your resume in English through this posting. We review every application.

Genesis Management is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need an accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, let us know at careers@genesisbpo.com — we're glad to help.

description:
About the job

Principal Function: The Order Fulfillment Specialist - Customer Success plays a critical role in efficiently receiving, reviewing, and processing all inbound customer purchase orders. This position ensures seamless coordination between customers, sales and internal teams, facilitates accurate order entry and timely fulfillment, and contributes to maintaining organized, compliant, and accurate internal processes.




Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Duties include, but are not limited to:




1. Customer Order Processing

Receive, review, and validate customer purchase orders to ensure accuracy of pricing, contractual terms, delivery requirements, and compliance with internal policies.
Request and coordinate product allocation, confirm material availability, and enter customer orders accurately into internal systems while monitoring order status through fulfillment.
Proactively track and resolve order delays or discrepancies, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Success teams to align on delivery timelines and customer expectations.
Generate and distribute sales order confirmations to customers, ensuring clear communication of order details and fulfillment milestones.
Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

2. Customer Outbound Logistics

Plan, select, and execute all outbound customer shipments, balancing, cost efficiency, service reliability, and customer-specific delivery requirements.
Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.
Identify recurring logistics challenges and contribute to continuous improvement efforts aimed at enhancing delivery performance, visibility, and overall customer satisfaction.

3. Customer Support

Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and a solutions-oriented approach that reinforces thrust and long-term partnership.
Act as an extension of the Sales team by supporting customer requests, identifying upsell or follow-on order opportunities, and ensuring seamless handoffs between Sales and Operations.
Communicate extensively with customers, carriers, brokers, and internal teams via high-volume email and time-sensitive phone calls, responding promptly to inquiries, issues, and escalation needs related to active orders and shipments.
Prepare, retrieve, and distribute customer-requested documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates, and shipping records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

4. Other

Carry out other duties to support departmental and organizational objectives.




Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty according to the requirements of the Company. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities.




Company-Related Competencies: To perform their jobs successfully, all employees working in the St. Louis Group should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Ethics – Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works ethically and with integrity; Upholds Company values.

· Professionalism – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for personal actions; Follows through on commitments.

· Problem Solving – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

· Written and Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and obtains clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings; Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Reads with the ability to interpret written information.

· Teamwork – Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others’ views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone’s efforts to succeed.

· Adaptability – Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.




Job-Related Competencies – To perform this job successfully, employees in this job should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Quality and Quantity – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality; Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly but efficiently.

· Customer Service – Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

Other Skills and Abilities: The following skills and abilities are either required or desired.

description:
About the job

Why this role exists




Charles, our founder, spends most of his week talking with the owners of short-term rental property management companies. Five or six of those conversations get recorded every week, and almost nobody sees them. Your job is to change that. You'll take everything he says on camera and turn it into the newsletter, clips, and posts that make him the best-known voice in this industry. He hits record and reviews your drafts once a week. Everything in between belongs to you.

About HostGenius




HostGenius is a private membership network and business operating system for short-term rental property management companies. More than 70 member companies managing about 3,000 properties run on our platform. Charles scaled his own property management company to 160 listings before starting HostGenius, so when he talks about this business, operators listen. We're profitable and growing fast, and this role turns his daily conversations into a growth channel.

What success looks like




A year from now, thousands of US property managers read our weekly newsletter. Clips go up on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube every week, and every word sounds like Charles wrote it himself. He spends under two hours a week on content once the cameras are off. The sales team uses proof clips you found. The ads team runs creative you handed them. When we host an industry event, you stretch one week of recording into three months of material.




What you will own

Turning raw recordings into published content. You pick the moments worth keeping, cut clips with Riverside's Magic Clips, and write the hooks and captions.
Final copy for the weekly newsletter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Our AI pipeline produces first drafts for you. You run it, check it, and edit everything until it sounds like Charles.
The publishing calendar. Everything ships on time every week without anyone chasing you.
The weekly review with Charles. One approval pass. You ship what he approves and rework what he flags.
A weekly scoreboard: what shipped, newsletter growth, engagement from actual property managers, and which clips went to the ads team.
Freelance editors, once long-form YouTube outgrows Magic Clips. They cut, you direct.




Not in scope: paid ads (our Growth Marketing Manager owns Meta), long-form video editing (we will outsource it), and inventing strategy from scratch. The system is already designed. Your job is to run it every week and keep making it better.




What we are looking for




Required:

3+ years running content production end to end for a company, founder, or creator, with published work you can show us
Written English at a native level. You'll be ghostwriting a Canadian founder, and if your copy needs a second edit before it ships, this isn't your role. Finalists complete a paid writing test in his voice.
Good instincts for short-form video. You can listen to an hour of conversation and know which 40 seconds will stop someone scrolling.
The discipline to run a publishing calendar for months without missing a date
At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time
You use AI tools daily for speed, and you catch what they get wrong




Nice to have:

Experience marketing to small business owners, or in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rentals
You've grown a newsletter on beehiiv, HubSpot, Kit, or similar
Podcast or webinar production, or familiarity with Riverside.fm
Enough design sense to make covers and carousels in Canva




Compensation

$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month as a full-time contractor plus up to a 30% annual bonus. This is a long-term role with upside as the media engine grows.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Make sure your resume or profile links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you personally produced. We read every application that includes work samples and skip the ones that don't. Finalists complete a short paid writing test.

description:
About the job

About The Team

Shopper Journey Services (SJS) is Zillow’s engine for authenticated user intent and a core enabler of Home Details Page (HDP) experiences. We gather rich, explicit and implicit signals from authenticated shoppers and co‑shoppers, refine them into durable models, services, and display‑ready data, and activate those capabilities across Zillow’s ecosystem to deliver personalized, high‑quality experiences. Our charter spans two tightly connected areas: User Intent & Applied AI, where we build the pipelines, services, and evaluation capabilities that turn user signals into intelligence and AI‑powered experiences, and the HDP Backend Platform, where we power HDP with robust, low‑latency, display‑ready data. AI is both a product capability and an engineering accelerator for this team, and we are investing in LLM‑ and ML‑powered workflows, evaluation, and agentic systems while modernizing our conventional backend stack.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI Services to build and scale end‑to‑end intelligent systems that power personalized experiences and HDP‑aligned capabilities.

This is a hands‑on IC role where you’ll spend most of your time writing code and driving technical design for impactful production systems. You will operate at the intersection of:


Scalable backend services (APIs, events, data stores, cloud infrastructure), and
Applied AI/ML systems (offline data ingestion, feature and signal pipelines, LLM/ML‑powered capabilities, evaluation frameworks, and AI‑driven workflows). 


You will help turn user intent into intelligence, safely bring new AI capabilities from 0→1, and scale them across Zillow’s shopper journey surfaces.

You Will Get To


Lead end‑to‑end delivery of features — from early prototypes to production‑hardened systems. 
Work deeply with AI/ML workflows while applying solid engineering and reliability practices. 
Design, build, and maintain data pipelines (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Python, Kafka or equivalents) that turn raw events and signals into durable features and model inputs. 
Develop and integrate ML/LLM capabilities (e.g., embeddings, similarity search, ranking, clustering, text generation) into backend flows and expose them via stable, well‑versioned services and APIs for product teams to consume. 
Design and iterate on prompts, configurations, and AI workflows using notebooks and offline experimentation, and build automated evaluation systems (e.g., LLM‑as‑judge, regression suites, sampling pipelines) with clear quality metrics for accuracy, safety, latency, and cost. 
Translate prototypes into reliable, observable production systems with solid tests, deployment pipelines, and on‑call readiness; own their operational health through runbooks, incident reviews, and continuous improvements, while optimizing for performance, reliability, and cost. 
Collaborate closely with AI/ML and Agentic AI teams to bring 0→1 AI capabilities to customers and evolve them to 1→N, partner with SJS and HDP engineers on clean interfaces between offline pipelines, model outputs, and online APIs/events, and contribute reusable libraries, templates, and examples that help other engineers ship AI‑powered features faster. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


You are strongly proficient in at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, or similar, and have delivered scalable services or APIs to production in a cloud environment (e.g., AWS, GCP), including thoughtful data modeling and performance tuning. 
You have hands‑on experience with data processing or distributed systems (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Kafka or similar data pipelines) and are comfortable designing and consuming APIs (REST or GraphQL). 
You’ve worked with ML or LLM‑based systems and shipped at least one feature or capability to production, in partnership with an AI/ML team or self‑built. 
You’re familiar with embeddings, ranking, clustering, recommendations, or other ML applications that support personalization and search/browse experiences. 
You have experience with prompt engineering and LLM‑based product development, including safety/guardrail considerations and offline/online evaluation frameworks for AI‑powered features. 
You are comfortable in modern infrastructure environments (e.g., Kubernetes‑based deployments, event‑driven architectures, and observability stacks) and can translate prototypes into robust, observable, well‑tested production systems. 
You have a track record of owning projects end‑to‑end — from requirements and design through implementation, rollout, operations, and cross‑functional collaboration with product, design, and data science partners. 
Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non‑traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences. 


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

description:
About the job

Senior Sales Executive – Experiential Marketing & Fabrication (Remote)Company Description

Vukler Studio is a custom fabrication and experiential production studio that transforms creative concepts into high-impact physical experiences. We specialize in custom sets, props, installations, branded environments, event activations, and large-scale fabrication for agencies, brands, production companies, entertainment, and live events.

Our team combines creative problem-solving, advanced fabrication techniques, and traditional craftsmanship to bring ambitious concepts to life. From initial design and engineering through fabrication and delivery, Vukler Studio works closely with clients to create visually compelling, durable, and memorable experiences.

Role Description

Vukler Studio is seeking an experienced Senior Sales Executive to generate new business and expand our client network.

This is a fully remote position, and candidates may be located anywhere in the world. The primary focus of this role is business development within the U.S. market, particularly with experiential marketing agencies, event agencies, production companies, creative agencies, brands, exhibit companies, and other organizations requiring custom fabrication.

This is an outbound sales-focused position. We are looking for someone who knows how to identify opportunities, reach decision-makers, build relationships, and convert those relationships into qualified projects and long-term clients.

Key Responsibilities
Identify and prospect new potential clients throughout the U.S.
Conduct outbound outreach through phone calls, email, LinkedIn, and other sales channels.
Build relationships with experiential agencies, event producers, creative agencies, production companies, brands, exhibit companies, and other potential partners.
Identify upcoming activations, events, installations, campaigns, and fabrication opportunities.
Generate qualified leads and bring new RFQs, RFPs, and project opportunities to Vukler Studio.
Present Vukler Studio's capabilities, portfolio, and fabrication services to prospective clients.
Understand client requirements and coordinate with our estimating, design, and production teams to develop proposals.
Follow up consistently on estimates, proposals, and open opportunities.
Negotiate and close projects while maintaining strong client relationships.
Maintain an organized sales pipeline and accurately track leads, opportunities, follow-ups, and results.
Develop long-term relationships that generate repeat projects and referrals.
Research new agencies, brands, markets, and potential strategic partners.
Qualifications
Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, and new client acquisition.
Strong preference for candidates with experience in experiential marketing, event production, custom fabrication, exhibits, trade shows, scenic fabrication, sets and props, branded environments, or related creative industries.
Demonstrated ability to generate new business through outbound prospecting rather than relying solely on inbound leads.
Strong cold-calling, cold-emailing, LinkedIn prospecting, and follow-up skills.
Experience communicating and selling to agencies, producers, marketing teams, creative directors, brand managers, and other decision-makers.
Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to understand custom, project-based services where every project may have different specifications, budgets, and timelines.
Ability to manage multiple sales opportunities simultaneously and maintain consistent follow-up.
Experience using CRM and sales prospecting tools.
Strong written and spoken English.
Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Ability to work hours that provide reasonable overlap with U.S. business hours.
Location

Remote – Worldwide

Candidates do not need to be located in the United States. We welcome experienced sales professionals from anywhere in the world who can successfully develop relationships and generate business within the U.S. market.

Ideal Candidate

We are particularly interested in candidates who already understand the experiential marketing, event production, and custom fabrication industries and ideally have an existing network of agencies, producers, brands, or other potential clients.

The ideal candidate is proactive, persistent, highly organized, and results-driven. You should be comfortable opening doors, reaching new decision-makers, developing relationships from scratch, and turning those relationships into real project opportunities.

This is an opportunity to represent a growing fabrication studio capable of executing unique, creative, and large-scale projects for clients throughout the United States.

Liderar la implementación de exhibiciones alineadas a los objetivos estratégicos de cada país, sirviendo como punto de conexión directo con los equipos locales de Merchandising, Perfect Store, Shopper Marketing y Marketing para alinear prioridades y aterrizar necesidades estratégicas y comerciales del mercado.

Asegurar que tanto las agendas TEMP como PERM se integren dentro del catálogo digital LATAM, impulsando la homologación de procesos, ingenierías y materiales entre países. Esto incluye coordinar con proveedores locales para que la producción se ejecute sin desviaciones respecto a las ingenierías liberadas, y participar en los entrenamientos y la liberación de prototipos validando estándares de calidad.

Impulsar iniciativas de sustentabilidad, con énfasis en la reducción de la huella de carbono en los exhibidores, y colaborar en la evolución del proceso WCCE junto a los equipos de Customer Engagement y CCO.

Representar al equipo de DX Merchandising en foros transversales con áreas como Digital Transformation, Procurement y GBS, entre otras.


Porcentaje de soluciones armonizadas y estandarizadas por canal y país. 
Incremento en productividad y cobertura a través de modelos escalables. 
Reducción de la huella de carbono en exhibidores. 
Nivel de adopción del catálogo digital regional por parte de los países. 
Avances en los procesos WCCE vinculados a Perfect 10 (showroom virtual, realidades extendidas). 
Satisfacción y nivel de alineación con los equipos locales de Brasil y SoCo. 


Qualifications

¿A quién buscamos?


Formación en diseño industrial, arquitectura, ingeniería o carreras afines, con experiencia comprobable en la implementación de soluciones físicas en entornos de retail. Buscamos a alguien con sólida capacidad de gestión transversal y trabajo colaborativo, que se mueva con comodidad entre equipos y geografías.
En lo técnico, es importante el conocimiento de materiales, procesos de fabricación y homologación. En lo estratégico, una visión orientada a la eficiencia, la sustentabilidad y la escalabilidad. Se requieren excelentes habilidades de comunicación, análisis y negociación, tanto en español como en inglés; cualquier idioma adicional es un plus. La experiencia previa en ambientes multiculturales o regionales será un diferenciador. 


Si esta es una oportunidad que te interesa, te alentamos a postularte aún si no cumples con el 100% de los requisitos.

Lo que puedes esperar de nosotros:


Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas. 
Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning. 
Programas de desarrollo de acuerdo con habilidades de Liderazgo. 
Entrenamientos especializados de acuerdo con el rol. 
Experiencias de aprendizaje con proveedores internos y externos. 
Nos encanta celebrar el éxito, por lo que contamos con programas de reconocimiento por antigüedad, comportamientos, liderazgo, momentos de vida, entre otros. 
Programas de bienestar financiero que te ayudarán a alcanzar tus metas en todas las etapas de la vida. 
Un programa de flexibilidad que te permitirá balancear tu vida personal y laboral, adaptando tu jornada laboral a tu estilo de vida. 
Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros. 


En PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos con impulsar un equipo de trabajo diverso al crear un espacio colaborativo, equitativo e incluyente, en donde todos y todas independientemente de cómo nos vemos, de dónde somos o a quién amamos- tengamos una voz. Ofrecemos oportunidades únicas para contratar personas calificadas y diversas, independientemente de su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, edad o discapacidad.

description:
About the job

Comparte tu experiencia e impulsa a la próxima generación de emprendedores

¿Has construido una comunidad en redes sociales? ¿Has desarrollado estrategias digitales para marcas o proyectos? ¿Te apasiona compartir conocimiento y enseñar desde la experiencia?

En Liberu estamos desarrollando un programa de capacitación dirigido a emprendedores del sector de alimentos que buscan fortalecer su presencia en redes sociales, conectar con nuevos clientes y hacer crecer su negocio mediante estrategias digitales.

Para ello, buscamos especialistas con experiencia comprobada que deseen impartir workshops prácticos, dinámicos y basados en casos reales.







¿Qué tipo de perfiles buscamos?

Estamos en búsqueda de profesionales con experiencia comprobable en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

Social Media Management
Planeación Digital
Marketing Digital
Branding Digital
Creación de Contenido
Influencer Marketing
Community Management
Producción de Contenido

También invitamos a postularse a creadores de contenido que hayan desarrollado comunidades sólidas y deseen compartir su experiencia.







¿Qué buscamos en un speaker?

Más allá de la experiencia profesional, buscamos personas capaces de enseñar de forma clara, cercana y práctica.

Valoraremos especialmente perfiles que:

Disfruten compartir conocimiento.
Expliquen conceptos de manera sencilla.
Enseñen a partir de experiencias reales.
Tengan facilidad para hablar frente a grupos.
Inspiren a emprendedores y pequeños negocios.
Promuevan el aprendizaje mediante ejercicios y ejemplos prácticos.

Nuestro objetivo no es ofrecer clases teóricas, sino talleres que permitan a los participantes aplicar lo aprendido desde el primer día.







Programa de capacitación

El programa estará conformado por cuatro módulos, distribuidos durante dos semanas.

Cada speaker será seleccionado para impartir uno de los siguientes módulos.

Módulo 1Fundamentos de las Redes Sociales para Negocios

Temas de referencia:

Importancia de las redes sociales para un negocio.
Diferencias entre plataformas.
Errores comunes.
Casos de éxito.
Buenas prácticas.







Módulo 2Estrategia de Contenido para Negocios

Temas de referencia:

Definición de objetivos.
Conocimiento del cliente.
Planeación de contenido.
Calendario editorial.
Organización de publicaciones.







Módulo 3Creación de Contenido para Redes Sociales

Temas de referencia:

Desarrollo de ideas.
Grabación con celular.
Producción de contenido.
Comunicación frente a cámara.
Casos reales y aprendizajes.

Temas de referencia:

Interpretación de métricas.
Optimización del contenido.
Gestión de comunidad.
Mejores prácticas.
Planes de mejora.

Para todos los perfiles
Excelente capacidad de comunicación.
Disponibilidad para impartir sesiones de capacitación en línea.
Interés por compartir conocimiento con emprendedores.

Proceso de selección1. Recepción de postulaciones

Revisaremos la experiencia profesional, trayectoria y propuesta preliminar de cada candidato.

2. Entrevista con Liberu

Los perfiles preseleccionados participarán en una videollamada para conocer su experiencia, metodología de enseñanza y estilo de comunicación.

3. Desarrollo de la propuesta final

Los speakers seleccionados trabajarán junto con el equipo de Liberu para desarrollar y adaptar el contenido definitivo de su workshop, alineándolo con los objetivos del programa.

4. Selección final

Se confirmarán los especialistas que impartirán cada uno de los módulos del programa.

Compartir tu experiencia con emprendedores que buscan hacer crecer sus negocios.

description:
About the job

Reuters Events is seeking a commercially minded and data-driven Jr. Marketing Manager to lead the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across a portfolio of global conferences and content products. Reporting to the Senior Marketing Lead, this role will be responsible for driving audience growth, lead generation, delegate acquisition, and engagement among senior executive communities.

The Jr. Marketing Manager will work cross-functionally with product, sales, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver high-impact, multi-channel campaigns that support business growth and strengthen Reuters Events' market presence.

About The Role

As a Jr. Marketing Manager within Reuters Events, you will:


Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns for Reuters Events conferences, digital content, and related products.
Drive delegate acquisition, audience growth, and lead generation through targeted go-to-market strategies.
Identify and implement innovative ways to reach senior executive audiences across key industry sectors.
Build and manage channel, media, and marketing partnerships to support event promotion and customer acquisition.
Plan and deliver multi-channel campaigns across email, web, content, paid media, partnerships, and social channels.
Monitor, analyse, and optimize campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics and Salesforce.
Track key marketing KPIs and provide regular reporting and insight to stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with internal teams including sales, content, and event operations to ensure campaign alignment and commercial success.
Support database growth, audience segmentation, and targeted outreach initiatives.
Ensure strong brand positioning and consistent messaging across all marketing activity.


About You

To be a Jr. Marketing Manager within Reuters Events, you will likely have:


Proven ability to develop and execute B2B marketing campaigns and strategies, ideally within events, media, or professional services.
Strong background in campaign planning, demand generation, and audience development.
Experience delivering integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
Ability to use data and reporting to evaluate campaign performance and drive optimization.
Familiarity with platforms such as Google Analytics, Salesforce and email marketing systems.
Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Commercially aware, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
Please note that while the title includes 'Manager,' this is an individual contributor role focused on managing and executing company events, not managing a team or direct reports.


Preferred Experience


Experience marketing to senior executive or C-level audiences.
Experience working with external partners, media partners, or agencies.
Understanding of lead generation and customer acquisition strategies in a B2B environment.


What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

About the job

Position Title: Trade Marketing Associate Manager – Professional Beauty Mexico

Location: CDMX, Mexico

Scope / Brands: Professional Beauty

About The Wella Company

Together,  WE  enable individuals to look, feel, and be their true selves.

Wella Company is one of the world’s leading beauty companies, comprised of a family of iconic brands such as Wella Professionals, Clairol, OPI, Nioxin and ghd. With 6,000 employees globally, presence in over 100 countries, Wella Company and its brands enable consumers to look, feel, and be their true selves. As innovators in the hair and nail industry, Wella Company empowers its people to delight consumers, inspire beauty professionals, engage communities, and deliver sustainable growth to its stakeholders.

For additional information about the Wella Company please visit www.wellacompany.com .

 THE ROLE 

We are looking for a highly driven, analytical, and execution-oriented Trade Marketing Associate Manager to join our Professional Beauty team in Mexico.

This role is responsible for developing and executing trade marketing strategies that accelerate sustainable growth, strengthen brand presence, and improve commercial performance across direct customers, distributors, and key professional beauty channels.

The Associate Manager will act as a key link between Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams, translating brand and commercial priorities into effective customer and channel plans. The role will also be responsible for identifying business opportunities through performance analysis, optimizing the trade marketing mix, and ensuring the timely and effective execution of launches, promotions, visibility initiatives, and distribution plans.

Key Responsibilities


 Develop and execute customer and channel specific trade marketing plans for the Professional Beauty portfolio, ensuring alignment with brand strategies, commercial priorities, and business objectives. 
 Analyze business performance, including sell-in, sell-out, distribution, customer performance, promotional effectiveness, category trends, inventory levels, and building blocks, translating data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. 
 Identify growth opportunities by brand, customer, channel, and product portfolio, and partner with Sales and Marketing teams to develop initiatives that address business needs and improve performance. 
 Lead the trade marketing planning and execution of product launches, commercial initiatives, promotions, customer activations, and visibility programs, ensuring timely and consistent implementation. 
 Coordinate with Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and regional or global teams to ensure alignment, feasibility, and on-time delivery of key projects and initiatives. 
 Develop volume forecasts and demand assumptions for product launches, distribution expansions, promotional activities, customer opportunities, and brand initiatives, incorporating sell-in, sell-out, and inventory trends. 
 Track and evaluate the performance of building blocks, promotions, activations, launches, and trade investments, identifying learnings and recommending improvements for future executions. 
 Prepare and present business reviews, including commercial performance, key opportunities, risks, competitor activity, and recommended action plans, to senior stakeholders. 
 Manage and monitor trade marketing budgets related to promotions, visibility, activations, and customer initiatives, ensuring proper allocation, financial discipline, profitability, and return on investment. 



Qualifications

Essential:


 Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Commercial Management, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or a related field. 
 At least 3 years of relevant experience in Trade Marketing, Customer Marketing, Commercial Planning, Sales, Category Management, or a related function, preferably within the beauty, consumer goods, retail, or FMCG industries. 
 Strong analytical capabilities, and solid understanding of trade marketing fundamentals, including distribution, assortment, pricing, promotions, visibility, customer planning, and performance measurement. 
 Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
 Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and influence cross-functional stakeholders. 
 High level of ownership, accountability, initiative, and attention to detail. 
 Commercial mindset and strong orientation toward results, execution, and continuous improvement. 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. 
 Professional proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with local, regional, and global stakeholders. 



 Desirable: 


 Experience in professional beauty, hair care, cosmetics, personal care, or salon industry. 
 Experience working with distributors, wholesalers, retail customers, or multiple commercial channels. 
 Experience managing trade marketing budgets, promotional evaluations, or return-on-investment analysis. 
 Knowledge of demand planning, forecasting, inventory management, or sales and operations planning processes. 
 Previous experience working in a global, regional, or matrixed organization. 



 EEO OPPORTUNITIES

title: O que pouca gente fala sobre marketing: anunciar no offline pode ser um baita negócio!
description:
About the job

Todo mundo foi para o digital. O Instagram, o Google, o TikTok. E faz sentido: é onde as pessoas estão, o custo de entrada é baixo e dá para medir quase tudo.

Só que quando todo mundo foi para o mesmo lugar, uma coisa ficou para trás. E essa coisa é, talvez, a oportunidade de mídia mais subestimada do momento para pequenas e médias empresas.

Estou falando do offline.

Outdoor, rádio, jornal, busdoor, panfleto bem feito, patrocínio de evento local. Formatos que a maioria das empresas abandonou correndo para o digital e que, exatamente por isso, ficaram com menos disputa, menos ruído e mais espaço para quem quiser aparecer.

O que os números dizem sobre isso?

Antes de continuar, vale um dado que surpreende muita gente.

O setor de mídia exterior cresceu 20,6% no primeiro semestre de 2025 no Brasil, segundo o painel CENP Meios. O investimento passou de R$ 1,18 bilhão para R$ 1,42 bilhão em apenas um ano. E o mercado publicitário brasileiro como um todo movimentou R$ 95,2 bilhões em 2025, com crescimento de 8,2% em relação ao ano anterior.

Ou seja, é um setor que cresce e ficou mais seletivo e, por isso, mais interessante para quem entra com estratégia e disciplina.

Menos concorrência, mais chance de ser lembrado!

Pense no feed do Instagram da sua cidade. Quantas empresas estão lá, publicando todo dia, disputando a mesma atenção do mesmo público?

Agora pense em quantos outdoors bem posicionados existem pelas ruas, com anúncio dos seus concorrentes?

Provavelmente poucos. E poderia ser o seu.

Porque não é inviável. São investimentos viáveis mesmo para pequenas empresas, desde que tenha o mínimo de planejamento por trás. Quando a concorrência está toda concentrada no digital, os outros canais ficam com espaço livre. E espaço livre em publicidade significa custo menor por impacto e muito menos disputa pela atenção do público.

Credibilidade que o digital ainda não consegue replicar

Tem um efeito psicológico interessante no offline que poucos empresários param para pensar.

Quando uma empresa aparece num outdoor, num anúncio de jornal ou numa rádio local, o consumidor associa isso a solidez. A presença física numa mídia tradicional ainda carrega um peso de legitimidade que o anúncio do Instagram, por mais bem produzido que seja, ainda não tem da mesma forma.

Existe uma coisa que as empresas mais lembradas pelos consumidores têm em comum. Sabe o que é?

Anunciam no offline. É ali que constroem marca, credibilidade e reputação. O digital traz clique, o offline fica na cabeça.

Isso vale especialmente para empresas B2B, serviços de ticket médio alto, mercados mais conservadores e públicos com mais de 35 anos. São justamente os perfis que tomam decisões de compra mais relevantes e que ainda consomem mídia offline com regularidade.

Segmentação geográfica que o digital dificulta

O digital permite segmentar por interesse, comportamento e dados demográficos. Mas segmentar geograficamente com precisão local ainda é um desafio real para pequenas empresas.

Um outdoor na entrada do porto de Santos fala diretamente com quem trabalha com logística portuária. Um anúncio no jornal da região fala com quem lê notícias locais. Uma inserção na rádio da cidade no horário do rush fala com quem está dirigindo para o trabalho.

Essa precisão de contexto é difícil de replicar no digital sem um orçamento significativo. No offline, ela já está embutida no próprio formato.

Como usar o offline de forma inteligente hoje?

Offline sem estratégia é dinheiro jogado fora, assim como digital sem estratégia. A diferença é que o erro no offline custa mais caro e aparece mais devagar.

Algumas Diretrizes Que Fazem a Diferença

Escolha o formato certo para o seu público. Rádio funciona bem para empresas de varejo e serviços locais. Mídia exterior funciona bem para construção de marca e lembrança. Jornal e revista segmentada funcionam bem para B2B e públicos com perfil de tomador de decisão.

Use o offline para construir marca e o digital para capturar a demanda gerada. Os dois trabalham melhor juntos do que separados. O consumidor vê o outdoor, depois pesquisa no Google. Se você não aparece na busca, perdeu a oportunidade que o offline criou.

Invista em criação. Anúncio offline mal feito causa o efeito contrário: passa imagem de amadorismo. O formato exige qualidade de produção porque não tem algoritmo para compensar um criativo fraco.

O momento certo para entrar

A janela está aberta agora. Com a migração massiva para o digital, muitos formatos offline estão com espaço disponível, preços negociáveis e menos concorrentes disputando a atenção do mesmo público.

O digital continua sendo essencial. Mas depender só dele, enquanto o offline está com espaço, preço acessível e menos briga por atenção, é deixar dinheiro na mesa sem precisar.

A Plug Comunicação planeja e executa campanhas offline e online para empresas da Baixada Santista há mais de 20 anos. Se você quer entender qual mix de mídia faz mais sentido para o seu negócio, fale com a gente.

Environment: Typical office workspace environment with a quiet-to-moderate noise level. Standard hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; however, international shipping timelines may occasionally require flexibility beyond these hours or on weekends.

About the job

Company Description

Aragon Chemical is a leader in delivering high-quality chemical solutions across diverse industries. With decades of experience and a history of success, the company is built on a foundation of commitment, innovation, and reliability. Aragon Chemical is dedicated to providing tailored products that meet the specific needs of its clients. Through its enduring excellence, Aragon Chemical has solidified its reputation as a trusted industry partner.




Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico, for a Logistics Coordinator. The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for managing and execution of the Company’s global and US domestic logistics operations. This role coordinates and monitors the full lifecycle of US purchase orders, warehouse transfers, and inbound shipments (both international and US domestic) to ensure timely, accurate delivery. The position works closely with suppliers, dray carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, and internal production/material teams to support efficient operations, maintain inventory accuracy, and meet compliance standards.




Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Inbound Shipment Tracking & System Management (Visco & Portals)

System Integrity: Update and maintain the Visco ERP system with critical shipment milestones, including Master Bill of Lading (MBL), Container Numbers, and tracking details.
Status Monitoring: Monitor and update statuses in Visco ERP (e.g., At Source, in Transit Status).
Data Maintenance: Track and input Lot Numbers into Visco ERP and systematically update the internal PO Tracker.
Exception Management: Proactively identify, log, and resolve transit delays; provide detailed documentation and reasoning if a shipment remains in transit for more than 10 days.




2. International & Domestic Logistics Operations

Supplier & Carrier Alignment: Confirm domestic shipment readiness and departure dates with domestic suppliers.

Platform Operations: Generate Bills of Lading (BOL) on the 3rd Party provider’s platform to facilitate collection and logistics execution.
Inbound Order Management: Create Inbound Orders within the Warehouse Management System (WMS) for all international and domestic inbound shipments.




3. Inventory Control & Warehouse Transfers (WHTs)

Documentation: Generate necessary collection and delivery documentation for warehouses and meticulously maintain the tracking report. Collect and audit the documentation from the suppliers. Report and work through any issues to ensure documentational compliance.

Teamwork & Adaptability: Balance individual tracking responsibilities with broader operational goals. Embrace frequent changes, unexpected supply chain disruptions, or scheduling delays with agility.

Planning and Organization: Prioritize multiple competing shipments simultaneously, organize freight schedules efficiently, and create highly realistic action plans.
Quality and Quantity: Demonstrate extreme accuracy and thoroughness in data entry (Visco, tracking sheets) where minor errors can cause significant logistical delays.

Experience: 2 - 3 years of hands-on experience in procurement, freight forwarding, or logistics within a small to medium-sized corporate environment is preferred.

Language & Communication Skills
